user.title: Connect to Souliss Gateway
user.description: Enter the Souliss Gateway parameters. The USER_INDEX and NODE_INDEX pair must be unique among SoulissApp, openHAB and every other user interface.

data_description.host: LAN IPv4 address or hostname of the Souliss Gateway.
data_description.local_port: Dedicated UDP listening port used by this Home Assistant integration.
data_description.user_index: Must not duplicate another Souliss user interface.
data_description.node_index: Must not duplicate another Souliss user interface.

error.cannot_connect: Could not contact the Souliss Gateway. Check IP, UDP port, firewall and Souliss Gateway configuration.
error.invalid_host: The host could not be resolved to a valid IPv4 address.

abort.already_configured: This Souliss Gateway is already configured.
